brief.claim: In a 50-voxel region of medial prefrontal cortex, the voxels that track trait social anxiety have a mean activity that predicts the trait: the least-squares slope of the standardized trait score on the standardized mean activity of those voxels across the 16 subjects is at least 0.50, with one-sided p < 0.05.

data_keys.meaning: activation (beta) to a social-evaluation task; two scanning sessions on separate days
